knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Release needs every mandatory check and every required approval. A tidy look is not enough, and finishing early is not a release condition.
Unfamiliar electrical or gas appliances are not operated by the cleaner to show that they work.
The fault is recorded, secured only if the procedure permits, and a reinspection is requested before release. Hiding it or leaving it is not acceptable.

practicalCriteria: Confirms the acceptance criteria from a sample checklist, and sorts each item into what the cleaner approves and what needs coordinator sign-off.
Carries out a hazard scan before cleaning, and stops and reports a simulated hazard.
Completes a timed simulated turnover in a safe order, with contact times built in and a final inspection buffer.
Records the simulated final-inspection findings, requests a reinspection, and does not release the property before it is recorded.
passRule: Criteria confirmed and sorted, hazard scan completed before cleaning, timed run completed safely, and findings recorded with reinspection requested before release. Observed in a supervised simulation. Not an appliance-function certificate and not a gas or electrical licence. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Release record with the approver's name and time
stopWorkCriteria: Property released before mandatory checks or approvals
Unfamiliar appliance operated by the cleaner
Gas smell investigated by the cleaner or the scan skipped
